code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia with severe arterial hypoxia and acidosis, anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild hypoalbuminemia. There is increased red cell distribution width and ferritin, mild lymphopenia, and elevated INR. Liver enzymes are low, but no evidence of acute myocardial injury or significant inflammation. Findings suggest possible chronic disease, respiratory failure, and coagulopathy; clinical correlation and urgent evaluation are recommended.
